answer: Sybil resistance here uses counterparty-volume gating: an identity only unlocks mining weight equal to the lesser of its locked stake and settled trade volume with distinct established peers this window. Trades among unestablished clones count zero. An attacker must buy genuine volume from many independent agents—a velvet capital sink that flows like a river and only finds haven when real counterparties settle. Bulk fakes thus spend more on fees than they can earn.
